E2-2026-T1-P1-S1.trunk: Ask people and a certain image springs to mind（向人们提起图书馆，某种形象便浮现出来）
structure: 祈使条件/引入：Ask people about public libraries
主句：and a certain image springs to mind
└ 冒号后同位说明(image)：dusty, old-fashioned, the sort of place
├ 定语从句〔省略that，修饰 place〕：you enjoyed as a child
└ 转折插入与疑问：but, rather like a British seaside town, would you go there now?
E2-2026-T1-P1-S1.logic: 句子先用祈使结构模拟提问场景，再列出刻板印象；最后以插入类比和反问，把“童年喜欢”与“现在还去不去”形成对照。
notes: spring to mind 意为“立刻浮现在脑海中”。
the sort of place 后省略关系代词that。
rather like 表示“颇有点像”。

E2-2026-T1-P1-S3.trunk: The reality is startlingly different（现实截然不同）
structure: 主句：The reality is startlingly different
└ 方式状语从句(as)：as I discovered
└ 时间状语从句(when)：when the culture department commissioned me
└ 宾补不定式：to conduct an independent review of English public libraries
└ 过去分词短语〔修饰 review〕：published yesterday
E2-2026-T1-P1-S3.logic: 主干先否定刻板印象，as说明作者如何得知，when再交代受委托评审的具体情境；published yesterday修饰评审报告。
notes: startlingly different 意为“不同得令人吃惊”。
commission sb to do 指“委托某人做某事”。
published yesterday 可理解为评审报告于昨日发布。

E2-2026-T1-P1-S19.trunk: The review recommends a campaign, the reintroduction of a scheme, and memberships（评审建议开展宣传、恢复计划并提供会员资格）
structure: 主句：The review recommends 三个并列宾语
│   └ 目的状语：to give libraries a stronger physical presence
├ 宾语二：the reintroduction of a scheme
│   └ 不定式〔说明 scheme〕：to enable members to use their card in any library in the country
E2-2026-T1-P1-S19.logic: recommend后用三个名词短语列出政策包；两个to do分别说明宣传活动和会员互通计划的具体目的或内容。
notes: branding campaign 指统一品牌识别与宣传活动。
physical presence 在此指现实环境中的可见度和存在感。
automatic memberships 指无需另行申请即可获得会员资格。
